prompt: I'm building a signup form in a Next.js + TypeScript app. I need a Zod schema for the form data: `email` (required, valid email format), `password` (min 8 characters), and `confirmPassword` (must exactly match `password`). When validation fails, I want to show a field-level error message under each input rather than one generic error. Also export the inferred TypeScript type for the form data so I can type the `useState` and the submit handler. Write the schema and the parsing/error-handling code to a file called `signup.ts`.
assertions: Uses .safeParse(), not the throwing .parse(), to validate the form data
Validates email with z.string().email() (or equivalent email check)
Enforces a minimum password length of 8 via .min(8)
Checks confirmPassword against password via .refine() or .superRefine(), with the error path set to confirmPassword
Exposes validation errors keyed by field (e.g. via .flatten() or issue.path), not just a single generic message
Exports the inferred TypeScript type for the form data via z.infer<typeof schema>
